name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Grimsby, Rope, and Jealousy belong to different suspects.

Revenge goes with at least one of Holloway, Candlestick, or Cleaver.

Grimsby goes with none of Pistol, Rope, or Secrecy.
Holloway goes with neither Pistol nor Revenge.
Pierce, Pistol, and Greed belong to different suspects.
